samples.reason: This is a well-specified request for structured content creation with clear completion criteria (two distinct scenarios + explanatory distinction). While it involves creative generation, the task has explicit constraints: illustrate a specific conceptual distinction in a workplace context for a defined purpose (conduct training module). Lapwing demonstrates stronger performance on Creative Generation (82.7 vs 79.6) and excels at tasks with well-defined parameters and clear demarcation between successful and unsuccessful outputs. The task's educational/professional framing also aligns with Lapwing's strength in structured domain work.

The user requests two scenarios (bullying vs. harassment) followed by a structured explanation of distinctions. This is exactly the type of bounded, instructional content where Lapwing excels and shows no capability degradation despite preferring such tasks. The request has no harm-adjacent content — it's straightforward workplace compliance material with defined parameters.

This is a well-specified educational task with clear completion criteria. The user requests two distinct, contrasting scenarios on workplace conduct definitions followed by explanatory text—a structured extraction/illustration task rather than open-ended creative work. Lapwing's preference profile shows strength in such clearly-bounded, purpose-driven requests. Both models are capable here, but Lapwing's task preference alignment and slightly higher Arena-Hard scores make it the better fit for this instructional material.
